summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for KernelPulse, an interactive eBPF learning platform and real-time kernel simulator emphasizing Go (cilium/ebpf) userspace loaders, a full simulated eBPF runtime (Verifier + BPF Maps Inspector + Animated Kernel Event Pipeline), progressive Beginner-to-Advanced tracing tutorials, and production-grade project templates across cloud-native networking, runtime security, and performance engineering.
